title: Private swimming pools.
officialText:
Private swimming pools shall comply with the requirements for safety and accessibility as provided
in Section 3109.3 and this section.
Exception: An above-ground private swimming pool which has a maximum water depth of 4 feet (1219mm) and an area not
exceeding 500 square feet (46.45 m2) that is accessory to an R-3 occupancy and is privately used for noncommercial purposes
shall not be required to comply with Sections 3109.3.1, 3109.3.2, 3109.5.2, 3109.5.3 and 3109.5.4.
